module.title: Payment Gateways, Transactions, Refunds and Payouts
module.business_purpose: A provider-agnostic payment layer supporting multiple gateways (card, wallet, bank transfer, local rails). Tokenized payment methods (never raw PAN), payment intents tied to invoices/bookings/ad spend, gateway transactions with authorize/capture, refunds, disputes/chargebacks, scheduled payouts to practitioners (CU-18), gateway settlements and signed webhook events. Posts to the general ledger (module 16) and reconciles against billing (module 17) — money never lives only in the gateway.
